application: Detect whether a mathematical solution contains an incorrect reasoning step.
positive_mapping: ProcessBench label >= 0; label -1 means every reasoning step is correct.

source.independent_unit: publisher solution ID, grouped by underlying problem where duplicates are detected
source.public_exposure: Public labels may have been seen by a pretrained judge; local final_test allocation does not establish model non-exposure.

predeclared_qualification_criteria.rationale: A reusable error detector must reliably catch erroneous reasoning, avoid rejecting correct solutions, cover nearly all planned items, and remain stable to presentation order. Wilson bounds, not point estimates, govern qualification.

pending_before_assessment: Derive and freeze one deterministic representative row per selected problem cluster; repeated solutions cannot inflate Wilson denominators.
Obtain a human-authored DomainReview receipt from the representative math-reasoning reviewer after assessment.
